description: Resolve a knowledge gap. Adds answer as a knowledge base FAQ under the gap's question and marks the gap resolved; the AI uses it from the next message. Counts against the plan's knowledge base cap (403 plan_limit_reached). Only an open gap can be resolved (409 not_open). embedding_pending true means the FAQ is saved and indexing finishes shortly. Ask the user for the answer, or confirm a suggested_answer with them first: it becomes what the AI tells customers.

answer.description: The answer the AI should give. Saved word for word as the FAQ answer.

name: resolve_knowledge_gap
